scope: Combined selected new allocator + frozen I56 allocator/model suites. Includes previous31; not additive and not full repository suite.
known_limitations: Native local transverse-response equality is a frozen-G engineering priority, not a stability/friction/trajectory guarantee.
Command rates may exceed original60/6 thresholds because these are now diagnostic only; soft smoothing remains in the secondary objective.
A failed or unverified solver returns the clipped native command; secondary optimality is not claimed for fallback.
